title: Sites, morphisms of sites and cohomology on an object of a site
statement: (1) A *site* $\mathcal C$ and its category $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ of abelian sheaves are as in [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives] (Stacks Sites, Definition 00VH). (2) *Cohomology over an object.* For $U\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$ and $\mathcal F\in\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ choose an injective resolution $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ (one exists by [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives]) and put $H^p(U,\mathcal F)=H^p(\Gamma(U,\mathcal I^\bullet))$, $\Gamma(U,\mathcal G)=\mathcal G(U)$; these are the right derived functors of the left exact functor $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F(U)$, independent of the resolution up to canonical isomorphism, and form a universal $\delta$-functor (Stacks Cohomology on Sites, Section 01FT). (3) *Continuous functors and morphisms of sites.* A functor $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ between sites is *continuous* if for every covering $\{V_t\to V\}$ of $\mathcal C$ the family $\{u(V_t)\to u(V)\}$ is a covering of $\mathcal D$ and for every morphism $T\to V$ the morphisms $u(V_t\times_VT)\to u(V_t)\times_{u(V)}u(T)$ are isomorphisms (Sites, Definition 00WV). Then $u^s\mathcal G=\mathcal G\circ u$ sends sheaves on $\mathcal D$ to sheaves on $\mathcal C$, and it has a left adjoint $u_s$, the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf $u_p\mathcal F(W)=\varinjlim_{(V,\,W\to u(V))}\mathcal F(V)$. A *morphism of sites* $f:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ is given by a continuous functor $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ such that $u_s$ is exact; then $f_*=u^s$ and $f^{-1}=u_s$ (left adjoint of $f_*$), on sheaves of sets and on abelian sheaves (Sites, Definition 00X1). The composite of the morphisms of sites given by $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $v:\mathcal D\to\mathcal E$ is the morphism given by $v\circ u$ (Sites, Lemma 03CB).
